name: Education Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public education data.

entries.title: Argentina Educational Information and Evaluation (Relevamiento Anual, Aprender)
entries.description: Argentina's national educational information and evaluation office: open databases from the Relevamiento Anual school census and the Aprender national assessments, school-level microdata, the national school registry, and an indicators query system.
entries.publisher: Ministerio de Capital Humano, Secretaría de Educación (Argentina)
entries.attribution: Secretaría de Educación, Ministerio de Capital Humano — Información y Evaluación Educativa
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The old URL /educacion/evaluacion-e-informacion-educativa redirects here. The page lists "Datos abiertos: Bases de datos de Aprender y Relevamiento Anual", "Reportes por escuela: Plataforma de microdatos por escuela", "Padrón Nacional de Establecimientos Educativos", and SICDIE, the indicators query system. The datos-abiertos page footer states "Los contenidos de Argentina.gob.ar están licenciados bajo Creative Commons Atribución 4.0 Internacional". The publisher name is taken from the URL path and ministry branding, and should be confirmed by a steward. The national open data portal, datos.gob.ar, did not respond this session.

entries.title: INEP Microdata (Brazil)
entries.description: Brazil's national education research institute's microdata for its surveys, exams, and assessments — the basic-education School Census, the Higher Education Census, ENEM, Saeb, Enade, and others — the primary source for Brazilian education statistics.
entries.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estudos e Pesquisas Educacionais Anísio Teixeira (INEP), Brazil

coverage.spatial: Brazil (school, institution, and individual level, de-identified)
coverage.temporal: varies by survey (multiple decades for the School Census)

entries.license: CC-BY-ND-3.0 (gov.br/inep site content licence; no separate licence stated for the microdata files)
entries.attribution: INEP — Instituto Nacional de Estudos e Pesquisas Educacionais Anísio Teixeira
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page lists microdata for the Censo Escolar, the Censo da Educação Superior, Enade, and other INEP surveys and exams. It notes that file formats are being restructured to remove the possibility of identifying individuals. The INEP Dados Abertos page states "Todo o conteúdo deste site está publicado sob a licença Creative Commons Atribuição-SemDerivações 3.0 Não Adaptada" (CC BY-ND 3.0). That is a site-wide statement, recorded as found; a steward should confirm whether it is meant to cover the microdata. The csv/zip formats come from INEP's usual distribution and weren't checked.

entries.title: CEPALSTAT (ECLAC statistics portal)
entries.description: The UN Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean's statistics portal: comparable regional and country indicators across demographic and social themes (including education), economic, and environmental statistics, with open data and an API.
entries.publisher: United Nations Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean (ECLAC / CEPAL)

coverage.spatial: Latin America and the Caribbean (country and regional aggregates)

entries.license: unverified — ECLAC terms of use page (cepal.org) returned a Cloudflare challenge this session
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200 to curl; the content only renders with JavaScript. In headless Chromium the menu shows "ESTADÍSTICAS E INDICADORES", "OPEN DATA/API", and a "Demográficos y sociales" theme listing "Población, maternidad, empleo, educación, ...". The footer links ECLAC's terms and conditions, but cepal.org returned a Cloudflare challenge, so the license is left unverified. The formats are assumed from the open data/API section and weren't checked.

entries.title: College Scorecard
entries.description: The Department of Education's institution- and field-of-study-level data on U.S. colleges: costs, student aid, completion, debt and repayment, and post-enrollment earnings, combining IPEDS, federal student aid records, and Treasury earnings data.

access.auth_note: The API (api.data.gov/ed/collegescorecard/v1/) requires a free api.data.gov key; bulk downloads need none.

entries.attribution: U.S. Department of Education, College Scorecard
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page says "This data was last updated October 15, 2026" and offers an all-data zip (536 MB) of institution-level files for 1996-97 through 2025-26. The API documentation page states that an API key is required for every request, with base URL https://api.data.gov/ed/collegescorecard/v1/schools. The note in the description about combining IPEDS, federal student aid, and Treasury data reflects the Scorecard's documented sources; a steward should confirm it.

entries.title: Costa Rica Ministry of Public Education — Education Statistics
entries.description: Official education statistics from Costa Rica's Ministry of Public Education: enrollment databases by school, year, and level, interactive dashboards, methodological documents, and analytical publications.
entries.publisher: Ministerio de Educación Pública (MEP), Costa Rica — Departamento de Análisis Estadístico
entries.license: unverified — no license found on the page checked
entries.attribution: Ministerio de Educación Pública de Costa Rica, Departamento de Análisis Estadístico
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200 (the old /indicadores-educativos URL redirects here). The page offers "estadísticas oficiales, tableros interactivos, bases de datos, documentos metodológicos y publicaciones analíticas". It lists downloadable databases such as "Matrícula inicial colegios 2014-2022 por año cursado y sexo" and "Matrícula inicial Escuelas Diurnas 2014-2022". The xlsx format and the license are unverified. It is the only Central American national education source reachable this session.

entries.title: Civil Rights Data Collection (CRDC)
entries.description: The Office for Civil Rights' mandatory survey of every U.S. public school district and school, collecting data on students' equal access to educational opportunity — course access, discipline, restraint and seclusion, harassment, and more — by race, sex, disability, and English learner status.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of Education, Office for Civil Rights (OCR)

coverage.spatial: United States (all public districts and schools in the 50 states, DC, and Puerto Rico)
coverage.temporal: school years through 2023-24 (recent downloadable files 2015-16 onward)

entries.attribution: U.S. Department of Education, Office for Civil Rights, Civil Rights Data Collection
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The site renders only with JavaScript; headless Chromium shows its description as "a mandatory survey of all public school districts and schools in the 50 states, Washington, D.C., and the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico". The downloads page (https://civilrightsdata.ed.gov/data) lists files for 2023-24, 2021-22, 2020-21, 2017-18, and 2015-16. Collections are usually biennial but the gaps vary, so cadence is irregular. The csv format is assumed from the download files and should be confirmed by a steward.

entries.title: Eurostat Education and Training Database
entries.description: Eurostat's official EU statistics on education and training — enrollment, graduates, teachers, expenditure, attainment, early leavers, and adult learning — harmonised across EU member states.

coverage.spatial: EU member states (plus some EFTA and candidate countries)

entries.license: CC-BY-4.0 (Eurostat copyright notice and free re-use of data)
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page shows the Education and training database with selected and detailed datasets. Eurostat's copyright notice (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/help/copyright-notice) licenses its content under CC BY 4.0. API and bulk access go through Eurostat's general dissemination services. The topic list in the description reflects Eurostat's usual education tables, not a check of each dataset.

entries.title: INEGI — Educational Characteristics of the Population (Mexico)
entries.description: Mexico's national statistics institute's education topic: school attendance, literacy, and educational attainment from the population censuses and intercensal survey, plus enrollment, efficiency, and staffing indicators for the national education system.
entries.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI), Mexico

coverage.temporal: 2000-present for the enrollment indicators shown; census years for population characteristics

entries.license: INEGI Términos de Libre Uso de la Información (free use with attribution)
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200, page title "Características educativas de la población". It describes school attendance, literacy, and schooling data, plus "el número de alumnos inscritos en los diferentes niveles educativos, indicadores de eficiencia y sobre los recursos humanos del sistema educativo nacional". It shows a net enrollment rate chart covering 2000-2022. INEGI's terms page (https://www.inegi.org.mx/inegi/terminos.html) allows use under its "Términos de Libre Uso", with attribution in the form "Fuente: INEGI, nombre del producto". The enrollment figures come from the Secretaría de Educación Pública, whose sites (sep.gob.mx, planeacion.sep.gob.mx) and Mejoredu's did not respond this session. API access through INEGI's indicator API wasn't checked.
scripts/check_links.py got HTTP 403 (bot protection) the same day, although a plain curl with a browser user agent and headless Chromium both got HTTP 200. Blocked is not dead; a later probe may report it as blocked.

entries.title: NAEP — The Nation's Report Card
entries.description: The National Assessment of Educational Progress, the largest continuing nationally representative assessment of what U.S. students know in mathematics, reading, science, civics, and other subjects, reported for the nation, states, and selected large districts.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of Education, National Center for Education Statistics (NCES), for the National Assessment Governing Board

coverage.spatial: United States (nation, states, participating urban districts)

entries.attribution: National Center for Education Statistics, National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP)
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page lists the subject Report Cards (mathematics, reading, civics, long-term trend, and others) and the Data Tools: Data Explorer, State and District Profiles, and the NAEP Data Service API. Assessments run on a rotating subject schedule (core subjects about every two years), so cadence is irregular. The 1969 and 1990 start dates come from NCES's usual description and weren't checked here. The publisher line follows NAEP's usual statement that NCES administers it under the Governing Board's policy.

entries.title: NCES Common Core of Data (CCD)
entries.description: The Department of Education's primary database on U.S. public elementary and secondary schools and districts — school directory, enrollment by grade and demographics, staffing, and district finance — reported annually by state education agencies.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of Education, National Center for Education Statistics (NCES)

coverage.spatial: United States (every public school and district)

entries.attribution: National Center for Education Statistics, Common Core of Data
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page links CCD Data Files, the CCD Data File Tool, data tables, and the School Locator; the Data Files page (https://nces.ed.gov/ccd/files.asp) loads in headless Chromium. The csv format and the multi-decade span come from NCES's usual CCD distribution and weren't checked file by file.

entries.title: NCES Digest of Education Statistics
entries.description: NCES's annual compendium of statistical tables covering American education from prekindergarten through graduate school — enrollment, teachers, attainment, finance, outcomes — drawn from government and private sources.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of Education, National Center for Education Statistics (NCES)
entries.attribution: National Center for Education Statistics, Digest of Education Statistics
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page offers the latest version of all Digest tables, archived tables for release years 1995 through 2025, and PDF versions from 1990 to 2020. Downloadable table formats (xlsx) are assumed from the Digest's standard table pages.

entries.title: NCES Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS)
entries.description: Annual institution-level data on every U.S. college, university, and technical or vocational institution that takes part in federal student aid programs, from 12 interrelated survey components: enrollment, completions, graduation rates, finance, staff, and more.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of Education, National Center for Education Statistics (NCES)
entries.attribution: National Center for Education Statistics, IPEDS
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page describes IPEDS as "a system of 12 interrelated survey components conducted annually", covering every institution that participates in federal student financial aid programs. It links Complete Data Files, Custom Data Files, the Access Database, and the Data Explorer, so formats are recorded as csv and accdb.

entries.title: ESCALE — Peru Ministry of Education Statistics
entries.description: The Peruvian Ministry of Education's Educational Statistics Unit portal: the annual Censo Educativo databases, school registry and location data, indicators, school maps, and online statistics.
entries.publisher: Ministerio de Educación del Perú (MINEDU), Unidad de Estadística Educativa
entries.license: unverified — no license found on the pages checked
entries.attribution: MINEDU — ESCALE, Unidad de Estadística Educativa
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31 in headless Chromium (title "Inicio - ESCALE - Unidad de Estadística Educativa"). The page announces "Se publicaron las bases de datos del Censo Educativo 2025" and the start of the 2026 census collection. It lists services, indicators, school maps, and "Estadística OnLine". Plain curl sometimes gets a Check Point CloudGuard bot-verification page, but scripts/check_links.py reported it ok (HTTP 200) the same day. If a later probe reports blocked, that is bot protection, not a dead link. The csv format and the license are unverified.

entries.title: Scottish Government School Education Statistics
entries.description: Official statistics on school education in Scotland: pupil and teacher censuses, class sizes, attendance and absence, exclusions, attainment and qualifications, school-level summary statistics, and pupil projections.

coverage.temporal: varies by series (2025 pupil and teacher census latest)

entries.license: OGL-UK-3.0 (Open Government Licence v3.0, except for graphic assets and where otherwise stated)
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page lists pupil and teacher characteristics from the annual censuses (2025 latest), summary statistics, class sizes, attendance and absence, exclusions, projections, and school-level dashboards. The footer states "All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except for graphic assets and where otherwise stated". It complements the England-only uk-dfe-explore-education-statistics entry. The formats are assumed and weren't checked.

entries.title: SITEAL — Education Trends Information System in Latin America
entries.description: The IIEP-UNESCO regional office's information system on education in Latin America: country profiles, regional overviews, statistical indicators, and databases of education policies and regulations for 19 countries, including Central America.
entries.publisher: UNESCO International Institute for Educational Planning (IIEP-UNESCO), Latin America and the Caribbean office

coverage.spatial: 19 Latin American countries (Argentina, Bolivia, Brasil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Cuba, Chile, República Dominicana, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, México, Nicaragua, Panamá, Paraguay, Perú, Uruguay, Venezuela)

entries.license: unverified — SITEAL links IIEP-UNESCO terms of use; no license text found on the pages checked
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200 (www.siteal.iiep.unesco.org redirects to siteal.iiep.unesco.org). The page lists country profiles for the 19 countries above, regional overviews, "Bases de información", "Indicadores estadísticos", and "Políticas y normativas". It is the most practical regional source for Central American countries without a reachable national education statistics site this session; Guatemala's statistics office timed out. The IIEP terms page rendered no license text, so the license is left unverified. Download formats weren't checked.

entries.title: Explore Education Statistics (UK Department for Education)
entries.description: The Department for Education's official statistics service for England — schools, pupils, attainment, further and higher education, children's social care, and the education workforce — with a data catalogue and public API.

coverage.spatial: England (national, regional, local authority, and school level depending on release)

entries.license: OGL-UK-3.0 (Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated)
entries.attribution: Department for Education, Explore education statistics
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page links a data catalogue and API documentation and states "All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated". The service is regulated by the Office for Statistics Regulation. Coverage is England only; education is devolved, so Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland publish their own statistics. Each official statistics release has its own schedule, so cadence is event. auth_required: false assumes the public API needs no key; a steward should confirm it.

entries.title: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS) Data
entries.description: The official UN source of internationally comparable education statistics, covering enrollment, literacy, attainment, and SDG 4 education indicators for UNESCO member states.
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200, redirected to www.uis.unesco.org/en). UIS Data Browser is the primary interactive access point; bulk SDMX downloads also available. Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.

entries.title: INEEd Aristas — Uruguay National Student Assessment
entries.description: Databases from Aristas, the national assessment of learning and school context run by Uruguay's National Institute for Educational Evaluation, along with INEEd's other education databases and its report on the state of education in Uruguay.
entries.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Evaluación Educativa (INEEd), Uruguay

coverage.spatial: Uruguay (national samples of primary and secondary students)

entries.license: unverified — no data license found; the site footer's rights notice belongs to its web designer, not the data
entries.attribution: INEEd — Instituto Nacional de Evaluación Educativa
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200 for both https://www.ineed.edu.uy/ and the "Bases de datos de Aristas" page. The menu lists "Bases de datos de Aristas" and "Otras bases de datos". No data license is stated: the footer's "Todos los derechos reservados" belongs to the site designer's credit. Not checked: the csv format and the assessment years covered.
